responsibility: Defines the abstract backend contract that the Go frontend targets when lowering its IR to GCC-specific code generation structures. It specifies the opaque backend object types (`Btype`, `Bexpression`, `Bstatement`, `Bfunction`, etc.) and the full set of virtual hooks for building types, placeholders for recursive Go types, variables, labels, functions, statements, constants, globals, and export-data sections, making this the central interface between the Go frontend’s language semantics and the backend implementation.
